card.name: Partway through dispense and similar words
card.fires_on: The first part of a longer word that is still unfinished, most often 'disp' or 'dispens' before 'ensed' or 'ing' in pharmacy instructions. It also fires on a few other word starts such as 'sore' (before 'ness') and 'zale<pl>' (before 'on').

modes.label: Dispense word starts
modes.description: The word 'disp' or 'dispens' is cut before its ending, in pharmacist instructions.
modes.example: Prior to<< dispens>>ing, tap vial until all powder

modes.label: Other unfinished words
modes.description: The start of another word or number, such as a drug name or year, that continues in the next piece.
modes.example: The recommended dose of zale<<pl>>on capsules for most nonelderly adults

card.writes: It suppresses adverbs of frequency such as 'consistently' and 'periodically', which hints at pushing the model to finish the word rather than add an adverb.
card.plain: It fires when a word such as 'dispensing' is only half written and the model is waiting for the rest.
